document.title: PiRC - Section 4: Allocation Period (Design Option 1)
document.description: Simple-model allocation: single-clearing-price LP formation via Deposit only, with an engagement-based discount bucket.

C.name: Total Pi Committed
C.description: Total Pi committed by participants to purchase tokens of a project.

p_list.name: Listing Price
p_list.description: Listing price (Pi per token) at which the LP is initialized.

T_equivalence.description: Purchase and liquidity buckets are set equal in size.

engagement_bucket.description: Engagement bucket is fixed at 5% of T.

total_supply_to_launchpad.description: Total tokens the project supplies to the Launchpad, forming the initial circulating supply at TGE.

purchase_portion.destination: Delivered to participants for committed Pi (C)

liquidity_portion.destination: Liquidity Pool (LP), deposited alongside all of C

engagement_portion.destination: Distributed to participants by engagement tier

lp_formation.description: The project deposits the entire committed Pi (C) from all participants, along with the liquidity bucket T_liquidity = T, into the Escrow Wallet. The Escrow Wallet deposits the full C Pi together with T tokens into the Liquidity Pool.

base_allocation.description: Participant i with commitment c_i receives base tokens at the listing price.

engagement_discount.description: T_engage = 5% of T provides a discount on p_list at purchase, based on participants' Engagement Score captured during the Participation phase. Discounts only apply to participants who commit Pi (no free-riders).

effective_price_by_tier.description: Assumes commitments roughly uniform across tiers.
effective_price_by_tier.x_axis_label: Engagement rank percentile (0 = most engaged, 100 = least engaged)

summary.lp_seed: All committed Pi (C) plus T tokens
summary.engagement_distribution: Top 1/3 gets 2/3 of T_engage; middle 1/3 gets 1/3; bottom 1/3 gets none
